scope: current mainline and every implemented historical FULL/AFS/calibration recipe
scientific_role: descriptive replication of previously inspected designs
fixed_seed_behavior: Each preserved recipe retains its original registered seeds; all runtime environment and resolved packages recorded
calibration_scope: Original and revised designs use preserved corrected numerical implementation; recalibration of old estimators does not certify the new compact nonlinear estimators
scientific_stops: Preserve failed calibration, competence, context eligibility and power outcomes; never lower thresholds. Skip dependent stages, continue independent ones.
historical_input_rebinding: New explicit receipts bind fresh FULL and AFS outputs; never impersonate historical run IDs, hashes, authorization or Git cleanliness.
reproducibility_limit: Fixed inputs, code, dependencies and seeds are auditable; bitwise agreement across GPUs, drivers or SVD/BLAS implementations is not guaranteed. PCA signs and degenerate bases may differ.
